HCF and LCM — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

HCF(a, b) * LCM(a, b) = a * b
LCM(a, b) = (a * b) / HCF(a, b)
HCF(a, b, c) = HCF(HCF(a, b), c)

Mnemonics

Higher Common Factor, Lowest Common Multiple for easy recall

Key Points

  • HCF is the greatest common factor of two or more numbers
  • LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers
  • HCF and LCM are used to solve problems involving fractions, ratios, and proportions
  • Prime factorization can be used to find HCF and LCM
